title: Common
description: Shared definitions referenced by the other schemas.

SchemaVersion.description: Wire-format version. Bump only for breaking changes.

Offset.description: Per-match sequence number of an event in the feed, starting at 0.

Period.description: 1-2 regular halves, 3-4 extra time, 5 penalty shootout.

MatchClockSeconds.description: Game clock in seconds (e.g. the second half starts at 2700). Clocks overlap across periods because of stoppage time, so always pair with period.

Point.description: Pitch coordinates [x, y] on a 120x80 pitch, oriented so the acting team attacks towards x = 120.
